value:
RE-CENSUS of game/game/combat with regnorm TU mode at commit d14f43b32, run because the reloc-VALUE comparison and the widened private-alias mapper post-date the previous census. It re-ranked the roster enough that the work order's nearest-first list was wrong in its first three places, and it named two functions that are DONE at source.

THE CENSUS, ranked by GENUINE structural rows then unpaired (44 paired functions, 34 fully EXACT):
DiffRate 0 genuine / 4 unpaired (2 displaced) - COUNT-MISMATCH label, but counts are 163/163
get_attn_pos 0 genuine / 4 unpaired (1 displaced) - counts 372/372
EnemyStartMissile 0 genuine / 1 unpaired
StandardCamera 5 genuine / 50 unpaired
PlayerStartMissile 35 / 87; InitPlayerMissiles 38 / 28; someone_will_be_off_screen 39 / 12; get_cam_wpos 44 / 75; screen_limitation 48 / 37; InitCamera 56 / 93.

WHAT MOVED. The work order queued InitCamera (59 genuine pre-census), screen_limitation (50) and three ~40-genuine missile/screen functions as nearest-first. Those numbers barely moved (56 and 48 now) but they are the FAR end of the roster, not the near end: EnemyStartMissile at ONE unpaired instruction and StandardCamera at five genuine rows were not on the list at all, and both yielded verified improvements this session (commits 4a3131f74 and 70ad51646). The lesson is narrow and worth keeping: a work order's ranking is itself a number, and AGENTS.md discipline 8 applies to it - remeasure before executing it.

TWO POSTPROCESSOR-CLASS CANDIDATES, both count-symmetric, both source-exhausted with literal probed_form trails, neither reachable by any source work this lane could find:
(1) DiffRate_8002951C, insns 163/163, real 24, regnorm 11 renaming / 0 STRUCTURAL / 0 genuine / 4 unpaired (2 displaced). The residual is one entry-sequence cluster of about four words with the SAME shape the pinned sibling cam_orient_to already carries as a copy_register_fields rule: the target forms base+idx*396 in the destination's own callee-saved home and advances it in place (`add r29,r31,r0` / `lfs f31,368(r29)` / `addi r29,r29,200`) while ours forms it in a scratch and offsets once (`add r4,r31,r0` / `addi r29,r4,200` / `lfs f31,368(r4)`), plus a one-instruction permutation of the addi past the lfs. attempt.RC_diffrate-address-taken-abs-and-decl-order.20260901.v1 records the in-place-advance axis as dead at two identical A/Bs with both forms written out literally, which meets the Mandatory-policy source-exhaustion bar.
(2) get_attn_pos_8002C9A8, insns 372/372, real 66, regnorm 29 renaming / 0 STRUCTURAL / 0 genuine / 4 unpaired. attempt.CB_get-attn-pos-frame-deficit-and-lfd-cluster-cap.20260901.v1 names the residual as exactly two words (a constant load's position and register class around the cos call) and records six distinct dead spellings across two sessions.
Both already NAME WebFrank as their remaining class. Neither was touched this session: a rule is not this lane's lever, and shipping one unilaterally is outside the Mandatory-policy boundary. They are queued here so the postprocessor lane can find them by measurement rather than by rediscovery.

ONE ANTI-CANDIDATE, recorded so nobody queues it on the strength of its low genuine count: StandardCamera_8002B828 shows only 5 genuine rows but its counts are ASYMMETRIC at T598/O601, and EnemyStartMissile shows 0 genuine but is asymmetric at T291/O290. Every postprocessor class is instruction-count-preserving, so a count-asymmetric function is outside all of them no matter how clean its genuine-row count looks. GENUINE ROWS AND COUNT PARITY ARE INDEPENDENT SCREENS AND BOTH ARE REQUIRED - ranking postprocessor candidates on genuine rows alone would have queued both of these wrongly.
